summary: MicroVision filed an 8-K reporting receipt on August 26, 2026 of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications notice confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement, and closing the matter. Noncompliance had been noticed January 12, 2026. The press release, dated August 31, 2026, quotes CEO Glen DeVos. The notice resolves a delisting overhang rather than a transaction; no price, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for renewed sub-$1 trading that could restart a 180-day compliance clock and any reverse-split commentary.
